title: How many times per week should a muscle be trained to maximize muscle hypertrophy? A systematic review and meta-analysis of evidence involving trained participants
population: Trained adults; resistance-training frequency for hypertrophy

keyFinding.enGB: With weekly volume equated, resistance-training frequency effects on hypertrophy are small to null in the pooled analyses.
